change: Use v7 FRONTIER preparation/write, fdatasync, and post-sync frontier publication/credit cleanup duration as coalescing feedback. Keep v4 fdatasync-only feedback; unchanged 100/400 us waits and 100 us classifier threshold.
counter_scope: Successful v7 Parallel cycles; excludes DATA work, coalescing waits, and waiter notification. New additive counters total cycle nanoseconds and cycles promoted from short to long wait because full cycle >=100 us but fdatasync <100 us.
schedule: Four warmups per cell; odd scored pairs old_v4,new_v4,old_v7,new_v7; even pairs reverse. Same 1 KiB values, 2 GiB target SST, fresh databases, pinned binary SHA. No concurrent build/test/profile/scored work.
cooldown: tmpfs: 3 seconds after each run; ext4: 30 seconds before first run and 10 seconds after every run.

initial_guards.ssd_material_gain: At least one SSD cell has median paired raw v7 throughput >=1.02 and v4-normalized >=1.00.

confirmation: Only if all initial guards pass: exactly five additional pairs for each SSD cell, same protocol/arms, plus four warmups per cell. Pool all ten pairs. All SSD guard floors/ceilings and material gain must still pass. Do not cherry-pick runs or continue rerunning to pass.
peaks: Report strongest scored throughput from every arm; compare only matching operation counts, SST size, sample cadence and writer count. Peaks are supplementary, not the retention gate.
on_rejection: Restore retained source and canonical baseline binary, run fresh required checks, preserve all failed captures and exact rejected patch/source manifests.
